author: KiritoYAZ
quote: Overhyped simulator slop. This 99 critic score is a disgrace to humanity in general and the gaming industry in particular. It is full of glitches that other games were slandered for, yet this was glazed just for being Rockstar—as usual. I am here trying my best to save this industry from this rubbish, alongside others who really understand what games are and how they are an art form in themselves, not just realistic graphics and simulators. This game is the definition of mid
